items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I worked opposite everybody, Tommy Dorsey, Benny Goodman, Chick, Erskine Hawkins, Les Brown, you know, everybody. We were the house group.

ctx.x: Whoever came in there. Tommy Dorsey, Bunny Berigan, Erskine Hawkins, Teddy Hill, even -- what's the champion runner from Munich, Jesse Owens had a band.
